meta.name: frontend-engineer
meta.description: Pro frontend engineering discipline. Enforces build-test-verify workflow for every web project. Never declare done until the site is built, tested, responsive, accessible, and visually verified in a real browser. Use alongside vercel-cli for production-quality deployments.

copy.tagline: 构建、测试并验证前端项目，确保高质量交付
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要专业的前端工程实践和自动化质量保障
copy.tagline_en: Build, test, and verify frontend projects for high-quality delivery
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need professional frontend engineering and automated quality assurance

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照构建-测试-验证的流程开发前端项目，在真正完成前会进行浏览器截图验证，确保代码质量、响应式设计和可访问性。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 开发或修改一个前端网页项目时触发，尤其是涉及 React、Next.js 或 Vercel 部署的任务。

say.text: 帮我用 Next.js 创建一个个人博客页面。
say.note: Claude 会先分析需求，然后按流程构建、测试并截图验证。

say.text: 给这个 React 组件添加响应式样式。
say.note: Claude 会修改代码，并在不同屏幕尺寸下截图验证。

say.text: 部署当前项目到 Vercel 并检查线上效果。
say.note: Claude 会构建、部署，然后截图线上页面进行对比。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude follows a build-test-verify workflow for frontend projects, taking browser screenshots before declaring completion, ensuring code quality, responsive design, and accessibility.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to develop or modify a frontend web project, especially those involving React, Next.js, or Vercel deployment.

say_en.text: Create a personal blog page with Next.js.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze requirements, build, test, and verify with screenshots.

say_en.text: Add responsive styles to this React component.
say_en.note: Claude will modify code and verify at different screen sizes.

say_en.text: Deploy the current project to Vercel and check the live site.
say_en.note: Claude will build, deploy, and screenshot the live URL for comparison.
